reference.name: Opening a generated Created At distinct-values URL from raw table retains the wrong table result
reference.summary: Opening a generated Created At distinct-values URL from raw table retains the wrong table result.
reference.expected: The page shows the single-column "Created At: Day" distinct-values result that this URL showed when opened from the reference page.
reference.actual: The address bar shows the distinct-values URL, but the page still shows the "Release Requests" title, the six columns (ID, Region, Category, Approved, Amount, Created At) and the full timestamps. This was still true after waiting 8 seconds.
reproSteps: Click Release operations > Tables in Release operations > Release Requests > Fields in this table > Created At > All distinct values of Created At. A single 'Created At: Day' column with 6 dates appears. Copy the URL (/question#eyJkYXRhc2V0X3F1ZXJ5...).
Open /reference/databases/2/tables/9 and click 'See this table'. The raw table with 6 columns appears.
In the same tab, enter the copied distinct-values URL in the address bar and wait.
Result: the address changes, but the raw six-column Release Requests table is still shown.

knownHits.reason: Both describe same-tab navigation to a different serialized /question# URL leaving the previous query and results displayed. The address-bar navigation matches the reference case; the source and destination queries differ only in test content.
